prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: Values-matched AI giving advisors already exist, but at small scale, so the Main KPI of 1,000,000,000 donors with an AI giving advisor is unmet. Products include The Life You Can Save's GPT-based SmartAdvisor (December 2025), BBB Wise Giving Alliance's AskGive (August 2025) and TIFIN Give's Louise (https://www.finanzen.net/nachricht/aktien/the-life-you-can-save-launches-ai-powered-smartadvisor-to-help-donors-maximize-global-impact-15329917, https://give.org/news/askgive-ai-charitable-giving-launch); Daffy recommends grants from history and preferences and lets ChatGPT users give from their fund (https://help.daffy.org/en/articles/11037910-how-is-daffy-using-ai). Open-source values-matching exists in small projects such as MatchMission and Donatelo (https://github.com/280jayden/MatchMission). About 61 to 64 percent of people worldwide give each year, several billion donors, mostly in faith and community giving outside these US-centred tools (https://www.philanthropy.org.au/news-and-stories/nearly-two-thirds-of-the-planets-population-gave-to-charity-last-year-world-giving-report-2025/). Honest limit: a values-to-charity chatbot is a known answer, so building another is not new work; open work is reach beyond US donor-advised funds and recommendations validated against measured impact.
